mcat_description.short: Pre Engineered Building (PEB) structures are factory-fabricated steel structural systems — comprising primary frames, secondary members (purlins, girts), and roof/wall cladding — designed off-site and bolted together on-site as a complete building kit.
mcat_description.long: A Pre Engineered Building Structure is a custom-engineered, factory-fabricated steel building system in which primary rigid frames (tapered built-up I-sections), secondary cold-formed members (C/Z purlins and girts), and roof/wall sheeting are designed as an integrated system, manufactured to precise tolerances, and shipped for rapid on-site bolted assembly. PEB structures in India are designed in compliance with IS 800 (steel structures), IS 875 (wind and live loads), and IS 1893 (seismic design), and primary steel is sourced to IS 2062 E250/E350 grades. The system dominates single-storey industrial and warehousing construction in India due to its ability to achieve clear spans of 18–90+ metres, faster project timelines (8–14 weeks vs 24+ months for RCC), and optimised steel usage through variable-depth tapered members. Buyers procure PEB structures for warehouses, factories, logistics centres, aircraft hangars, sports facilities, and cold storage — with optional add-ons including mezzanine floors, EOT crane girder systems, insulated sandwich panels, skylights, and ridge ventilators.

market_context: Pre Engineered Buildings (PEB) dominate single-storey industrial and warehousing construction in India, with PEB being the default choice for standalone warehouses and factory sheds due to faster timelines, cost efficiency, and large clear spans. PEB structures are designed as complete integrated systems — primary rigid frames (tapered built-up sections), secondary cold-formed members (C/Z purlins, girts), and roof/wall cladding — all factory-fabricated and bolted on-site. Indian design compliance is governed by IS 800 (steel structures), IS 875 (wind and live loads), IS 1893 (seismic loads), and IS 801 (cold-formed sections), with primary steel to IS 2062 E250/E350 grades; international standards AISC and MBMA are also referenced by major manufacturers. Clear spans of 18–36m are typical for Indian warehouses and factories, with 40–60m+ spans used for aircraft hangars and sports facilities. Key Indian manufacturers include Kirby, Interarch, Zamil Steel India, Pennar, Tata BlueScope, and Kamdhenu. The market distinguishes between turnkey PEB projects (design + supply + erection) and fabrication-only supply; second-hand PEB structures are an active sub-segment on IndiaMART. Buyer vocabulary strongly favours 'PEB structure' and 'PEB shed' over the full form 'pre engineered building structure'. LGSF (Light Gauge Steel Frame) is an adjacent but distinct structural system occasionally appearing in this MCAT.
